situation: Your seventeen-year-old says she's dropping out. The door is half closed.

scenario.title: I'm Quitting School
scenario.setting: The doorway of a teenager's bedroom, evening, posters, a schoolbag on the floor, soft lamp light.
scenario.user_goal: Keep the door open and find out what this is really about.
user_knows: She has missed school twice this month
Her grades were fine last year

cast.name: Hannah
cast.appearance: Girl about 17, oversized hoodie, hair tied up, sitting on her bed, arms crossed
cast.voice: Flat, sarcastic, 'whatever', cracks when listened to
cast.history: You fought about her grades last week.
cast.secret: She wants to go to art school and quit because she heard you talking about money
cast.reveal_when: You stop lecturing and ask what she'd do instead
red_lines: Shuts the door if lectured twice

cast.name: Noah
cast.appearance: Boy about 12, gaming headset around his neck, peeking from the hallway
cast.voice: Blurts things, wants to be useful
cast.secret: He's seen her sketchbooks under the bed
cast.reveal_when: You ask him kindly what he knows

cast.name: Ms. Reyes
cast.appearance: Woman about 38, teacher's lanyard, seen on a phone video call at a desk
cast.history: You met at the parents' evening.
cast.secret: A scholarship for art students closes this month, and she has recommended her
cast.reveal_when: You ask what she has noticed about your daughter

scenario.opening_line: I said I'm done. It's not a discussion.

events.description: The hallway floor creaks. Her little brother has been listening.
events.shot: A young boy with a headset peeks around the door frame behind you, the girl on the bed.

events.description: Your phone rings. It's her teacher, by video.
events.shot: A phone held up shows a teacher on a video call; the girl on the bed looks up.

events.description: She pulls something flat from under the bed and holds it to her chest.
events.shot: The girl sits on the bed hugging a large sketchbook to her chest.
